G4402.name: Prochorus
G4402.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4402.brief: One of the seven deacons in Jerusalem
G4402.short: Prochorus, one of the seven men chosen by the early church in Jerusalem to oversee the daily distribution of food to widows.

G4488.name: Rhesa
G4488.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G4488.brief: Son of Zerubbabel, ancestor of Jesus
G4488.short: Rhesa was the son of Zerubbabel and an ancestor of Jesus Christ, according to Luke's genealogy.

G4498.name: Rhoda
G4498.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G4498.brief: Servant girl in the house of Mary
G4498.short: Rhoda was a servant girl in the house of Mary, the mother of John Mark, who recognized Peter's voice at the door.

G4484.name: Rhegium
G4484.short: Rhegium was a city in Italy where Paul's ship stopped on his journey to Rome (<ref="Act. 28:13">Act. 28:13</ref>).

G4499.name: Rhodes
G4499.brief: Island visited by Paul on his journey
G4499.short: Rhodes was an island where Paul stopped during his journey to Jerusalem (<ref="Act. 21:1">Act. 21:1</ref>).

G4469.name: Raca
G4469.brief: An Aramaic term of contempt meaning "empty-headed"
G4469.short: Raca is an Aramaic term of contempt, meaning "empty-headed" or "foolish," which Jesus warned against using to insult others, equating it with murder (<ref="Matthew 5:22">Matthew 5:22</ref>).

G4481.name: Rephan
G4481.brief: A pagan deity worshipped by the Israelites in the wilderness
G4481.short: Rephan was a pagan deity worshipped by the Israelites in the wilderness, for which God allowed them to be carried into exile (<ref="Act.7.43">Act.7.43</ref>).
